Cast: Nord Greatshield.summary: Cast: Nord Greatshield is a Deep North-tier material. Crafted at the Black Forge (level 4) from Bloodgold, Mould: Nord Greatshield and Timberwood. Used to make Nord Greatshield. Intermediate: temper in the Frost Foundry (fuel Liquid Frost) to get Nord Greatshield.

Cast: Nord Greatsword.summary: Cast: Nord Greatsword is a Deep North-tier material. Crafted at the Black Forge (level 4) from Bloodgold, Mould: Nord Greatsword and Frozen Branch. Used to make Nord Greatsword. Intermediate: temper in the Frost Foundry (fuel Liquid Frost) to get Nord Greatsword.

Cast: Nord Knucklechains.summary: Cast: Nord Knucklechains is a Deep North-tier material. Crafted at the Black Forge (level 4) from Bloodgold, Mould: Nord Knucklechains and Long Claws. Used to make Nord Knucklechains. Intermediate: temper in the Frost Foundry (fuel Liquid Frost) to get Nord Knucklechains.

Cast: Nord Mace.summary: Cast: Nord Mace is a Deep North-tier material. Crafted at the Black Forge (level 4) from Bloodgold, Mould: Nord Mace and Timberwood. Used to make Nord Mace. Intermediate: temper in the Frost Foundry (fuel Liquid Frost) to get Nord Mace.

Cast: Nord Shield.summary: Cast: Nord Shield is a Deep North-tier material. Crafted at the Black Forge (level 4) from Bloodgold, Mould: Nord Shield and Timberwood. Used to make Nord Shield. Intermediate: temper in the Frost Foundry (fuel Liquid Frost) to get Nord Shield.

Cast: Nord Sledge.summary: Cast: Nord Sledge is a Deep North-tier material. Crafted at the Black Forge (level 4) from Bloodgold, Mould: Nord Sledge and Timberwood. Used to make Nord Sledge. Intermediate: temper in the Frost Foundry (fuel Liquid Frost) to get Nord Sledge.

Cast: Nord Spear.summary: Cast: Nord Spear is a Deep North-tier material. Crafted at the Black Forge (level 4) from Bloodgold, Mould: Nord Spear and Timberwood. Used to make Nord Spear. Intermediate: temper in the Frost Foundry (fuel Liquid Frost) to get Nord Spear.

Cast: Nord Sword.summary: Cast: Nord Sword is a Deep North-tier material. Crafted at the Black Forge (level 4) from Bloodgold, Mould: Nord Sword and Timberwood. Used to make Nord Sword. Intermediate: temper in the Frost Foundry (fuel Liquid Frost) to get Nord Sword.

Cast: Northern Vengeance.summary: Cast: Northern Vengeance is a Deep North-tier material. Crafted at the Galdr Table (level 3) from Ice, Nornathread, Hexen Trophy and Mould: Northern Vengeance. Used to make Northern Vengeance. Intermediate: temper in the Frost Foundry (fuel Liquid Frost) to get Northern Vengeance.

Cast: Robes of the Caller.summary: Cast: Robes of the Caller is a Deep North-tier material. Crafted at the Galdr Table (level 3) from Bloodgold, Mould: Robes of the Caller, Moose Hide and Nornathread. Used to make Robes of the Caller. Intermediate: temper in the Frost Foundry (fuel Liquid Frost) to get Robes of the Caller.

Cast: Spirit Caller.summary: Cast: Spirit Caller is a Deep North-tier material. Crafted at the Galdr Table (level 3) from Frozen Branch, Nornathread, Moose Trophy and Mould: Spirit Caller. Used to make Spirit Caller. Intermediate: temper in the Frost Foundry (fuel Liquid Frost) to get Spirit Caller.

Cast: Trousers of the Caller.summary: Cast: Trousers of the Caller is a Deep North-tier material. Crafted at the Galdr Table (level 3) from Bloodgold, Mould: Trousers of the Caller, Moose Hide and Nornathread. Used to make Trousers of the Caller. Intermediate: temper in the Frost Foundry (fuel Liquid Frost) to get Trousers of the Caller.

Cast: Trousers of the Protector.summary: Cast: Trousers of the Protector is a Deep North-tier material. Crafted at the Black Forge (level 4) from Bloodgold, Mould: Trousers of the Protector, Moose Hide and Leather Straps. Used to make Trousers of the Protector. Intermediate: temper in the Frost Foundry (fuel Liquid Frost) to get Trousers of the Protector.

Cast: Trousers of the Vanguard.summary: Cast: Trousers of the Vanguard is a Deep North-tier material. Crafted at the Black Forge (level 4) from Bloodgold, Mould: Trousers of the Vanguard, Elaking Hair Bundle and Seal Pelt. Used to make Trousers of the Vanguard. Intermediate: temper in the Frost Foundry (fuel Liquid Frost) to get Trousers of the Vanguard.

Birds' Nest.summary: Birds' Nest is a Swamp-tier buildable piece. Built with the Hammer from Writhan Roots, Acorns and Thistle near a Workbench.

Abandoned House.summary: Abandoned House is a ruin found in the Meadows. Its chests can hold Feathers, Coins, Amber and Flinthead Arrow and more. 13 variants of lone ruined wooden houses. WoodHouse2 chest can hold a Mysterious Axe Head, WoodHouse6 a Curious Axe Head (25% per roll). WoodHouse4/5 have no chest (only a 25% bee nest).

Abandoned Village.summary: Abandoned Village is a village found in the Meadows. Guarded by Boar. Its chests can hold Feathers, Coins, Amber and Flinthead Arrow and more. 20–29 buildings 500–2000 m from the world centre; boars roam the pens.

Draugr Village.summary: Draugr Village is a village found in the Meadows. Guarded by Draugr and Draugr Elite. Its chests can hold Feathers, Coins, Amber and Flinthead Arrow and more. Meadows, always more than 2000 m from the world centre. Draugr/Draugr Elite are locked inside houses and spawn from Body Piles. One room kind has its own chest table that can hold a Wooden Mace (2–4).

Combat Ruin.summary: Combat Ruin is a ruin found in the Meadows. Guarded by Skeleton. Its chests can hold Wooden Mace, Feathers, Torch and Flinthead Arrow and more. Wooden battle arena; chest hidden under the wooden platform opposite the main entrance; Evil Bone Pile spawns Skeletons.

Dolmen.summary: Dolmen is a ruin found in the Meadows. Guarded by Skeleton. Needs: Antler Pickaxe (or better) to dig/mine out the buried valuable. Meadows and Black Forest (earliest: Meadows). Skeleton spawns once at night (50%). Valuable spot: one of Coins 2–15 / Amber Pearl 1–3 / Amber 1–5 (10/20/30% by variant).

Viking Graveyard.summary: Viking Graveyard is a ruin found in the Meadows. Guarded by Skeleton. Its chests can hold Fire Arrow, Coins, Ruby and Amber Pearl and more. Needs: Antler Pickaxe (or better) to dig down to the buried chest/valuables (3–4 hits); Wishbone helps locate but is not required. Ship-shaped stone setting. Buried chest 80%; 2 skeletal remains (Bone Fragments); 50% buried valuable.

Sacrificial Stones.summary: Sacrificial Stones is a ruin found in the Meadows. A Vegvisir here points to Eikthyr's altar. World spawn point (1 per world). Pickable Raspberries, Mushrooms, branches (Wood) and stones; Eikthyr vegvisir.

Burial Chambers.summary: Burial Chambers is a dungeon found in the Black Forest. Guarded by Skeleton, Rancid Remains and Ghost. Its chests can hold Feathers, Flinthead Arrow, Ruby and Coins and more. Main early source of Surtling Cores (on stands). Skeletons respawn at the entrance; Evil Bone Piles, Rancid Remains and Ghosts inside.

Troll Cave.summary: Troll Cave is a cave found in the Black Forest. Guarded by Troll. Its chests can hold Wood, Stone, Ruby and Coins and more. 0–2 stone chests (56.3% each); up to 2 Trolls (75% / 33%) that never respawn. Yellow Mushrooms respawn.

Bear Cave.summary: Bear Cave is a cave found in the Black Forest. Guarded by Bear. Like a Troll Cave with a Bear (75%). Pickable Blueberries, Bone Fragments, many Yellow Mushrooms; no chest.

Smouldering Tomb.summary: Smouldering Tomb is a dungeon found in the Black Forest. Guarded by Skeleton, Brenna and Ghost. Its chests can hold Feathers, Flinthead Arrow, Ruby and Coins and more. Needs: Location revealed on Hildir's map table (Hildir quest 1); reaching Hildir needs a boat. Hildir's quest dungeon (3 per world). Miniboss Brenna drops Hildir's Brass Chest (carry back to Hildir; not portal-able). Burial-Chamber-style loot.

Greydwarf Ruins.summary: Greydwarf Ruins is a ruin found in the Black Forest. Guarded by Greydwarf and Greydwarf Shaman. Its chests can hold Feathers, Flinthead Arrow, Coins and Amber and more. Abandoned Outpost type: stone foundations. Ruin1 and StoneHouse3 always have a Black Forest chest; StoneHouse4 has none.

Greydwarf Tower.summary: Greydwarf Tower is a ruin found in the Black Forest. Guarded by Greydwarf and Greydwarf Brute. Its chests can hold Feathers, Flinthead Arrow, Coins and Amber and more. A Vegvisir here points to The Elder (30%). Stone tower guarded by 6–7 Greydwarfs (+20% Brute). Chest under the staircase; barrel in front.

Skeleton Tower.summary: Skeleton Tower is a ruin found in the Black Forest. Guarded by Skeleton. Its chests can hold Feathers, Flinthead Arrow, Coins and Amber and more. Half-destroyed stone tower; chest on the top floor (25% / 50% for variant 09); Skeletons. No vegvisir.

Contested Tower.summary: Contested Tower is a ruin found in the Black Forest. Guarded by Skeleton, Greydwarf and Greydwarf Brute. Its chests can hold Feathers, Flinthead Arrow, Coins and Amber and more. A Vegvisir here points to The Elder (30% of towers). Chest hidden in the tower wall (81.8%) plus one under the wooden floor (33%, only with the 6 Skeletons). Skeletons and Greydwarfs fight each other.

Greydwarf Camp.summary: Greydwarf Camp is a camp found in the Black Forest. Guarded by Greydwarf, Greydwarf Brute and Greydwarf Shaman. A Greydwarf Nest spawner (300 per world): Greydwarf 72%, Shaman 14%, Brute 14%. No chest.

Shipwreck.summary: Shipwreck is a ruin found in the Black Forest. Its chests can hold Coins, Amber Pearl, Ruby and Feathers. On shores of Black Forest, Swamp, Plains and Ocean (earliest: Black Forest). Chest 74.9%.

Big Rock Clearing.summary: Big Rock Clearing is a ruin found in the Black Forest. Unique (1 per world, >1000 m from centre): big rock ringed by 22 Mysterious Rocks (pickable Rock) and Thistle.

Sunken Crypts.summary: Sunken Crypts is a dungeon found in the Swamp. Guarded by Oozer, Draugr, Blob and Draugr Elite. Its chests can hold Withered Bone, Ironhead Arrow, Poison Arrow and Coins and more. Needs: Iron Gate opens with  Swamp Key dropped by The Elder. Main source of Scrap Iron. Body Piles spawn Draugr; Blobs/Oozers. Floor valuables: one of Coins 5–30 / Ruby 1–2 / Amber 3–10 / Amber Pearl 2–5 / Withered Bone.

Swamp Grave.summary: Swamp Grave is a ruin found in the Swamp. Guarded by Draugr, Draugr Elite and Skeleton. Its chests can hold Withered Bone, Ironhead Arrow, Poison Arrow and Coins and more. Ring of standing stones; Swamp chest in the centre (50%), 2 Body Piles + 1 Evil Bone Pile.

Swamp Runestone Tower.summary: Swamp Runestone Tower is a ruin found in the Swamp. Guarded by Draugr and Draugr Elite. Its chests can hold Withered Bone, Ironhead Arrow, Poison Arrow and Coins and more. A Vegvisir here points to Bonemass (30%). Half-destroyed round tower; Swamp chest 25.1%; Body Pile, Draugr, 32.1% Draugr Elite.

Abandoned Hut.summary: Abandoned Hut is a ruin found in the Swamp. Guarded by Wraith and Draugr. Its chests can hold Feathers, Flinthead Arrow, Coins and Amber and more. Ruined stilt houses. Black-Forest-type chest (10%, 75% in SwampHut4) guarded by a one-time Wraith (or Draugr in SwampHut4).

Inverted Tower (Swamp).summary: Inverted Tower (Swamp) is a ruin found in the Swamp. Guarded by Draugr Elite. Flooded well; up to 2 Draugr Elite (32.1% each). No chest.

Geyser.summary: Geyser is a spawner found in the Swamp. Guarded by Surtling. Fire geyser with 3 Surtling spawners that respawn every 5 minutes – a Surtling Core / Coal farm.

Infested Tree.summary: Infested Tree is a resource found in the Swamp. Up to 700 per world. Only source of Guck.

Frost Caves.summary: Frost Caves is a dungeon found in the Mountain. Guarded by Cultist, Stone Golem, Ulv and Bat. Its chests can hold Obsidian, Silver Necklace, Ruby and Coins and more. Cultists, Ulvs, Bats, rare Stone Golems at the frozen lake (with a Fishing Rod pickable). Fenris Hair/Claw on altars.

Howling Cavern.summary: Howling Cavern is a dungeon found in the Mountain. Guarded by Geirrhafa, Ulv, Bat and Tetra. Its chests can hold Obsidian, Silver Necklace, Ruby and Coins and more. Needs: Location revealed on Hildir's map table (Hildir quest 2). Hildir's quest dungeon (3 per world), Frost-Cave layout. Miniboss Geirrhafa drops Hildir's Silver Chest.

Abandoned Cabin.summary: Abandoned Cabin is a ruin found in the Mountain. Guarded by Stone Golem and Skeleton. Its chests can hold Onion Seeds, Amber, Coins and Amber Pearl and more. Log cabins above 100 m altitude; Mountain chest (Onion Seeds); one-time Stone Golem / Skeletons.

Mountain Tower.summary: Mountain Tower is a ruin found in the Mountain. Guarded by Skeleton. Its chests can hold Onion Seeds, Amber, Coins and Amber Pearl and more. A Vegvisir here points to Moder (63%, tower variant only). Tower variant: chests 59.4% + 18.1%; fort variant: central tower chest 50% and Evil Bone Pile 50%.

Inverted Tower (Mountain).summary: Inverted Tower (Mountain) is a ruin found in the Mountain. Its chests can hold Onion Seeds, Amber, Coins and Amber Pearl and more. Spiral well; Mountain chest at the bottom (75%). Unguarded.

Mountain Grave.summary: Mountain Grave is a ruin found in the Mountain. Needs: Pickaxe: skeleton buried ~4–5 pickaxe hits deep.

Drake Nest.summary: Drake Nest is a camp found in the Mountain. Guarded by Drake. Dragon Egg (respawns after 8 h) guarded by up to 3 Drakes (66% each). Above 100 m.

Forge of Potential.summary: Forge of Potential is a station found in the Mountain. Unique world station (1 per world): spends Battle/Protection Idols to push gear one quality past its maximum (65% success). No loot; the idols come from chests.

Fuling Village.summary: Fuling Village is a village found in the Plains. Guarded by Fuling, Fuling Shaman and Fuling Berserker. Its chests can hold Barley, Black Metal Scrap, Needle and Coins and more. Fuling, Shamans, Berserkers. Fuling Totem on an altar next to each bonfire (50%); Barley and Flax patches; Plains chests.

Fuling Outpost.summary: Fuling Outpost is a ruin found in the Plains. Guarded by Fuling. Its chests can hold Barley, Black Metal Scrap, Needle and Coins and more. A Vegvisir here points to Yagluth's altar. Restored outpost (StoneTower1) always has a Fuling Totem; top-floor Plains chest 50%.

Fuling Ruin.summary: Fuling Ruin is a ruin found in the Plains. Guarded by Fuling. Its chests can hold Barley, Black Metal Scrap, Needle and Coins and more. Small ruin; Plains chest at the top of the stairs; 2 Fulings.

Stonehenge.summary: Stonehenge is a ruin found in the Plains. Guarded by Fuling Berserker and Fuling. Its chests can hold Feathers, Obsidian Arrow, Silver Necklace and Coins and more. A Vegvisir here points to Yagluth (40%, variants 1/3/4/5). Centre chest (50%, variants 1–3) can hold a Fuling Totem (2.8%/roll). Fuling Berserkers / Fulings guard.

Tar Pit.summary: Tar Pit is a camp found in the Plains. Guarded by Growth. Only source of Tar (small nodes 4, big nodes 15; 69–108 Tar per pit). Growths respawn hourly.

Sealed Tower.summary: Sealed Tower is a dungeon found in the Plains. Guarded by Fuling, Fuling Shaman, Zil and Thungr. Its chests can hold Barley, Black Metal Scrap, Needle and Coins and more. Needs: Location revealed on Hildir's map table (Hildir quest 3); entrance on the roof. Hildir's quest dungeon (3 per world), open-air, traps. Bottom floor: Zil & Thungr (Hildir's Bronze Chest) and special chests with Egg, Chain, Amber Pearl, Coins.

stats.layout: up to 8 rooms in one stack, entrance included

Infested Mine.summary: Infested Mine is a dungeon found in the Mistlands. Guarded by Seeker, Seeker Soldier and Tick. Its chests can hold Minor Healing Mead, Minor Stamina Mead, Poison Resistance Mead and Sausages and more. Needs: No key. Hidden doors (blue runes) lead to treasure rooms; a Wisplight/torch helps. Main source of Black Cores (stands in treasure rooms), Sealbreaker Fragments and Royal Jelly (piles respawn every 4 h). Coin piles avg 138.5.

Infested Citadel.summary: Infested Citadel is a dungeon found in the Mistlands. Guarded by Seeker and The Queen. Needs: Dvergr Vault opens with  Sealbreaker crafted at Galdr Table. The Queen's arena (5 per world). Exterior lower floor has pickable Dvergr Tankards and Lanterns.

Dvergr Guard Tower.summary: Dvergr Guard Tower is a ruin found in the Mistlands. Guarded by Dvergr Rogue and Dvergr Mage. Needs: Breaking crates/structure under the Dvergr ward angers the Dvergr (use a cart or let monsters do it). Inhabited by Dvergr Rogues and Mages. Pickable Dvergr Lanterns and (rare) Dvergr Tankards.

Ruined Dvergr Guard Tower.summary: Ruined Dvergr Guard Tower is a ruin found in the Mistlands. Guarded by Seeker. Its chests can hold Coins, Wooden Greatsword, Hook and Black Marble Protection Idol and more. Seeker-infested ruined variants; one Dvergr Treasure Chest each (valheimdb). Small/large Yggdrasil Shoots inside.

Dvergr Lighthouse.summary: Dvergr Lighthouse is a ruin found in the Mistlands. Guarded by Dvergr Mage and Dvergr Rogue. Needs: Breaking crates/structure under the Dvergr ward angers the Dvergr. Two-storey black-marble tower with a big mist-light; pickable lanterns and tankards.

Dvergr Excavation Site.summary: Dvergr Excavation Site is a camp found in the Mistlands. Guarded by Dvergr Rogue, Dvergr Mage and Seeker. Needs: Breaking crates/structure under the Dvergr ward angers the Dvergr. Dvergr dig around Giant Remains; variant 3 is ruined and Seeker-infested.

Dvergr Harbor.summary: Dvergr Harbor is a camp found in the Mistlands. Guarded by Dvergr Rogue and Dvergr Mage. Coastal wooden dock; Dvergr Rogue/Mage.

Giant Remains.summary: Giant Remains is a resource found in the Mistlands. Guarded by Tick. Needs: Black Metal Pickaxe to mine. Skeletons of giants; 25% an Ancient Sword node in the stomach; Ticks in the ribs.

Ancient Armour Site.summary: Ancient Armour Site is a resource found in the Mistlands. Needs: Black Metal Pickaxe to mine. Giant helmet with swords stuck in the ground (Mistlands_Swords1–3, 33 each per world).

Rock Spire.summary: Rock Spire is a ruin found in the Mistlands. Guarded by Seeker. Its chests can hold Coins, Wooden Greatsword, Hook and Black Marble Protection Idol and more.

Dvergr Road Post.summary: Dvergr Road Post is a camp found in the Mistlands. Guarded by Dvergr Rogue and Dvergr Mage. Roadside post: Dvergr Rogue 50%, Dvergr Mage 50%. No loot.

Dvergr Viaduct.summary: Dvergr Viaduct is a ruin found in the Mistlands. Black-marble bridge pillars (1–3). No chest or pickables.

Charred Fortress.summary: Charred Fortress is a fortress found in the Ashlands. Guarded by Skugg (charred ballista), Charred Warlock, Charred Marksman and Charred Warrior. Its chests can hold Iolite, Jade, Bloodstone and Coins and more. A Vegvisir here points to Fader's altar. Needs: Walls/gates need tool tier 5 (Battering Ram or Catapult) – or climb the walls.

Putrid Hole.summary: Putrid Hole is a dungeon found in the Ashlands. Guarded by Morgen. Its chests can hold Molten Core, Charred Bone, Carapace Arrow and Coins and more. A Vegvisir here points to Place of mystery. One Morgen per hole (no respawn). 25% vegvisir to the first Mysterious Location.

Mysterious Location.summary: Mysterious Location is a ruin found in the Ashlands. Guarded by Charred Twitcher, Charred Warrior, Charred Marksman and Charred Warlock. A Vegvisir here points to Place of mystery and Tomb of Lord Reto. Needs: Find via Putrid Hole vegvisir (1st) / previous location (2nd); location 1 has no entrance – break a wall. Dyrnwyn quest: location 1 = Dyrnwyn Tip Fragment, location 2 = Dyrnwyn Blade Fragment, 4 Molten Cores each; elite (2★) Charred from a Monument of Torment.

Tomb of Lord Reto.summary: Tomb of Lord Reto is a dungeon found in the Ashlands. Guarded by Lord Reto, Charred Twitcher, Charred Warrior and Charred Marksman. Needs: Vegvisir at the 2nd Mysterious Location; break a wall of the 3rd location to reach the entrance. Unique. 2★ miniboss Lord Reto drops the Dyrnwyn Hilt Fragment.

Ashlands Ruins.summary: Ashlands Ruins is a ruin found in the Ashlands. Guarded by Morgen, Charred Twitcher and Charred Warrior. Grausten ruins with Fiddleheads and Smoke Puffs; one-time Morgen / Charred Twitcher spawns.

Charred Ruins.summary: Charred Ruins is a ruin found in the Ashlands. A Vegvisir here points to Fader's altar. Large cathedral-like Grausten ruins overgrown with Ashvine (Vineberry Cluster); vegvisir to Fader.

Dvergr Charred Tower Ruins.summary: Dvergr Charred Tower Ruins is a ruin found in the Ashlands. Guarded by Dvergr Rogue. Needs: Dvergr ward: breaking things angers the Ashlands Dvergr. 30 per world; Ashlands Dvergr (wiki) – valheimdb lists them as Dvergr Rogue spawners.

Volture Nest.summary: Volture Nest is a camp found in the Ashlands. Guarded by Volture. Up to 4 one-time Voltures; up to 6 Volture Eggs hidden under the nest (50% each).

Sulfur Arch.summary: Sulfur Arch is a resource found in the Ashlands. Rock arch with up to 20 Sulfur pickables (40% each) – valheimdb.

Monument of Torment.summary: Monument of Torment is a spawner found in the Ashlands. Guarded by Charred Twitcher and Charred Warrior. Standalone Monument of Torment spawner (300 per world): Charred Twitcher / Charred Warrior. No loot.

Mörkhalla.summary: Mörkhalla is a dungeon found in the Deep North. Guarded by Captive Fuling, Imprisoned Dvergr, Krigen and Hexen. Its chests can hold Ancient Coin, Draumyx, Grimvarn and Solryth and more. Needs: Gates of Mörkhalla opens with  Intricate Key (used up) dropped by Hexen 10% · made at Frost Foundry. Largest dungeon; Ancient Chests and Jotun's Chests, Captive Fulings, Imprisoned Dvergr, Krigen, Hexen. Breaking the Malicious Ice at the bottom starts a Jotun Invasion.

Winding Tunnels.summary: Winding Tunnels is a dungeon found in the Deep North. Guarded by Shadow, Eyeless One and Elaking. Its chests can hold Mould: Nord Axe, Mould: Nord Bow, Mould: Nord Mace and Mould: Nord Sword and more. Under the great halls of Deep North villages; Frostcore nodes and Luminous Larvae; Elaking and Eyeless Ones.

North Village.summary: North Village is a village found in the Deep North. Guarded by Shadow. Its chests can hold Charred Arrow, Charred Bolt, Coins and Torch and more.

North Memorial Place.summary: North Memorial Place is a ruin found in the Deep North. Its chests can hold Silver Necklace, Mould: Nord Atgeir, Mould: Nord Axe and Mould: Nord Greataxe and more. A Vegvisir here points to Aesir Passage. Up to 10 single-roll chests, each one Nord/staff mould or a Silver Necklace; vegvisir to the Aesir Passage.

Deep North Hut.summary: Deep North Hut is a ruin found in the Deep North. Its chests can hold Charred Arrow, Charred Bolt, Coins and Torch and more. Lone hut with one chest (Deep North chest table).

Lumber Camp.summary: Lumber Camp is a camp found in the Deep North. Its chests can hold Charred Arrow, Charred Bolt, Coins and Torch and more. Lumber camp with one chest (Deep North chest table).

Ship Setting (Deep North).summary: Ship Setting (Deep North) is a ruin found in the Deep North. Its chests can hold Charred Arrow, Charred Bolt, Coins and Torch and more. Northern ship-shaped graves: chest 45% (02) or up to 3 (03), Bone Fragments and northern valuables (Draumyx/Veydris/Grimvarn/Solryth).

Shipwreck (Deep North).summary: Shipwreck (Deep North) is a ruin found in the Deep North. Its chests can hold Coins, Silver Necklace, Feathers and Charred Arrow and more. Frozen shipwreck chest (75%): Coins, northern valuables, idols.
